notes: AEAT Manual practico de Renta 2024, Parte 1, Capitulo 14 (Adecuacion del impuesto a las circunstancias personales y familiares), 'Ejemplo 6. Contribuyente con un hijo adoptado en el ejercicio con discapacidad, residentes en la Comunidad Autonoma de La Rioja', printed pages 1226-1227. A menor of FIVE years of age, adopted by resolucion judicial of 5 May 2024 inscribed in the Registro Civil in November 2024, cohabiting, with no rentas above 8.000 euros and no own declaracion. CHOSEN FOR ONE PROPERTY: it is the only bundled example in which the Art. 58.2 bajo-3-anos increase is granted to a child who is NOT under three, and the manual states the reason in nota (2), quoting art. 58.2 verbatim -- 'en los supuestos de adopcion o acogimiento, tanto preadoptivo como permanente, dicho aumento se producira, con independencia de la edad del menor, en el periodo impositivo en que se inscriba en el Registro Civil y en los dos siguientes'. The printed descendientes rows are 'Minimo por descendientes 2.400' plus 'Incremento por menor 3 anos 2.800', which the engine folds into one aggregate, so the figure asserted for casilla 0513 is their sum: 5200.00. BOTH casillas are asserted because the manual's Nota previa states La Rioja exercised normative competence over the minimo por DISCAPACIDAD only -- nota (3) confirms the 3.000/3.300 divergence sits on that concept -- while both columns print the descendientes figures identically at 2.400 and 2.800. The minimo por discapacidad rows are OUT OF SCOPE and are not asserted here; this fixture grounds only what casillas 0513/0514 hold. The child's 40 per cent discapacidad grade does not enter those casillas. Art. 58.2 in force since 01/01/2015 (Ley 26/2014, BOE-A-2014-12327), unamended since, so the rule holds across 2020-2025.
